newsitem.title: PERU: Three-year-old Peru girl swims for Guinness record.
newsitem.headline: Three-year-old Peru girl swims for Guinness record.

text.p: A three-year-old Peruvian girl may have free-styled her way into the Guinness Book of World Records on Tuesday by swimming 1,000 yards (metres) in 48 minutes without stopping, local news reports said.
"No precedent exists. Only six and seven year girls have done this type of thing in groups without stopping," said Alejandro Gonzales, Guinness' representative in Peru.
Instead of 20 laps she set out to swim in the 25-yard (metres) pool, little Sofia Figueroa stroked along for 40.
Asked what instructions her coach gave her before diving off the platform, she said: "To lift my head up to one side (to breathe)."
Local television quoted the instructor as saying that Sofia would be champion material by the 2004 Olympics, but her mother already considers her a winner.

"If she's tired, she lets us know and stops. If she keeps going it's because she can continue," she told reporters. "We will give her all our support if she decides to continue with swimming. We'll help her, but the decision is hers."
